$comment: Generated by `yidam schema`. Regenerate rather than edit. A schema file without this line is the repository's own, and `yidam schema` refuses to overwrite it.
description: One node in .yidam/corpus/<class>/. An instance of its directory's ontology class, carrying at least one outgoing link — a node with no outgoing edge is not in the graph.

anyOf.description: An evidence standing: `verified`, `inference` or `open` — bare, bracketed, or bracketed with a detail that narrows what is asserted. `yidam lint` grades the value with the same reader that grades a node's `type: claim` property, and the reports read it — a tagged edge is counted by `status` and `corpus-index` and served by the MCP `claims` and `open_questions` tools.

source.description: What this edge rests on: a catalog entry by its file stem, a catalog entry by a path written the way `target` is, or a decision record by its `id`. `edge-source-unresolved` reports a value that names none of them, on every edge that writes one; `edge-verified-unsourced` reports a `verified` edge that writes none.
